headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment into ClearInstall to provide users with up-to-date information on potential vulnerabilities in their local-first projects. Leverage machine learning models to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansions.
actions: Implement a real-time vulnerability scanner that checks for known security issues in dependencies before installation.
Develop a machine learning model to predict potential vulnerabilities based on historical data and public threat signals.
Create an interactive dashboard within ClearInstall that highlights risky packages and provides actionable insights for users.
